headline: Compliance hearing for Sahel Restaurant & Lounge and a public hearing request for Brothers & Co. on Cabot Street.
summary: Two one-day wine and malt beverage license applications are listed, one for Bomb Shelter Comedy Showcase and one for Hive Public Market. A state request about a Keno license and a request to continue a Showcase Cinema Lowell license transfer hearing are on the agenda too.
items: Application for a one-day wine and malt beverage license for the Bomb Shelter Comedy Showcase on November 20, 2026, from 7 to 10 PM, at 175 Central Street (Sebastian Sarango)
Application for a one-day wine and malt beverages license for "Sip & Shop" at Hive Public Market on December 10, 2026, from noon to 2 PM, at 101 Paige Street (Rachel Chandler)
Massachusetts State Lottery Commission letter on a Keno license application from Lowell Asian Bakery and Restaurant, 369 Broad Street
Request to continue the public hearing on transferring the all alcoholic beverages restaurant license for Showcase Cinema Lowell, 31 Reiss Ave, to the December 3, 2026 meeting
Request for a public hearing on an all alcoholic beverages restaurant license for Brothers & Co. Sports Bar & Grille, 199-203 Cabot Street, to be held December 3, 2026

Police Superintendent Gregory Hudon's request for a compliance hearing on alleged misconduct at MBOA Alliance LLC, d/b/a Sahel Restaurant & Lounge, 135 Central Street, on October 29 and 31, 2026, to be held December 3, 2026
location: City Council Chambers, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St., Lowell, MA 01852
plain_text:
In 
compliance with Massachusetts General Law chapter 30A, sections 18–25, notice is hereby given that a meeting of the License Commission of the City of Lowell is scheduled to take place on Thursday, 
November 19, 2026, at 6:00 PM. Members of the public may attend in-person in the City Council Chambers, City Hall, 375 Merrimack St., Lowell, MA 01852.
Acceptance Of The Meeting Minutes For November 5, 2026. 
01. 20261105 LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT_02 MINUTES.PDF
Acceptance Of The Meeting Minutes For October 15, 2026. [C. Donahue, C. Krieger, C. Mercier]
03. 20261015 LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT_02 MINUTES.PDF
Acceptance Of The Meeting Minutes For September 17, 2026. [C. Krieger, C. Underwood, C. Uong]
02. 20260917 LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT_02 MINUTES.PDF
Application By Sebastian Sarango, For A "Special One Day License To Sell Dispense Wines And Malt Beverages" At The Bomb Shelter Comedy Showcase On Friday, November 20, 2026, From 7 To 
10 PM, At The Central Street Marketplace, 175 Central Street.
Application By Rachel Chandler, Hive Public Market, For A "Special One Day License To Sell/Dispense Wines And Malt Beverages Only," For "Sip & Shop" To Be Held On Thursday, December 10, 
2026, From Noon To 2 PM At Hive Public Market, 101 Paige Street. 
Communication From Massachusetts State Lottery Commission Regarding An Application For A KENO License Submitted By Lowell Asian Bakery And Restaurant, 369 Broad Street. In Accordance 
With M.G.L. Ch10 §27A, An Objection Of The City Must Be As A Result Of An Official Action Taken By The City Regarding The Keno Applicant. 
Request To Continue Public Hearing For An Application By HLE TargetCO LLC [D/B/A] Showcase Cinema Lowell, To Transfer Of The "All Alcoholic Beverages" Restaurant License For 31 Reiss Ave At 
The December 3, 2026, License Commission Meeting.
Request For A Public Hearing For An Application By BSBG & Co. [D/B/A] Brothers & Co. Sports Bar & Grille, For An "All Alcoholic Beverages" Restaurant License For 199 -203 Cabot Street. Request 
Public Hearing Be Held At The December 3, 2026, License Commission Meeting.
Communication Dated November 12, 2026, From Lowell Police Superintendent, Gregory Hudon, Regarding Allegations Of Misconduct Charged Against MBOA Alliance LLC [D/B/A] Sahel Restaurant & 
Lounge, 135 Central Street, Peter Tamajong, License Manager, All Alcoholic Beverages Restaurant Licensee. Allegations Of Misconduct Occurred October 29 & 31, 2026, Regarding Failure To Comply 
With Alcoholic Beverages Regulations For Licenses Issued By The Lowell License Commission, Specifically 1.16, 1.20, 2.04, And 2.16. Superintendent Hudon Requests That A Compliance Hearing Be 
Held At The December 3, 2026, License Commission Meeting.
09. 20261112 LPD COMM RE SAHEL COMPLIANCE.PDF
Adjournment.
The next License Commission meeting is scheduled for Thursday, December 3, 2026.
The deadline for physical application submissions is Tuesday, November 24, 8 PM.
The deadline for email application submissions is Noon, Friday, November 27, 2026.
Applications for annual alcohol license transactions should be submitted earlier to guarantee board review.
City Hall is closed Wednesday, November 25 through Sunday, November 29. License Commission will reopen Monday, November 30, 9 AM.
